limitations: No physical hardware, radio throughput, flash timing or power-loss acceptance is implied.
GC status reports handles, not unique retained groups or guaranteed reclaimable bytes. It never triggers collection.
Latest completed collector result includes successful zero and is unknown before a completed attempt in the current mount.
RTC timings measure elapsed instrumented regions, include overhead/interrupt latency, and are quantized. Index time overlaps flash and CRC; counters must not be summed as a total.
Profiling covers the last actual PackedFS scan, not configure/cache allocation, bootloader, display latency or snapshot time.
Saturated counters are lower bounds. In-progress/unavailable profiles export zero counters with compiled-only flag.
LeakSanitizer disabled for the sanitizer run; the synthetic NOR harness separately checks all tracked allocations are released.
nextDeviceStep: After installing the signed test build, restart the LCD, collect PXST v5 and PXGC at idle, then inspect the snapshot before/after a controlled create/delete and after closing retained readers; compare on-device timing without claiming additive CPU percentages.
